pages.text: Forge the Gravewarden's steel into a cleaver and it will grow holier, not with killing but with $(l)good deeds$(): every patient you cure, every corpse burned near you, every nest destroyed, every village saved, every champion of the plague brought down.$(br2)Each of its five levels adds a fifth to its harm against the Pestilence's creatures; from the third it sets them alight; at the fifth each one it fells mends you.
